name: Hans-Peter Keller
bio:
Hans-Peter Keller’s journey in motorsport began in the late 1980s, tinkering with Formula Ford engines in his father's garage. A brief stint as a driver revealed his true talent lay not behind the wheel, but in orchestrating the team. He rapidly ascended the ranks, proving himself a shrewd strategist and exceptional man-manager. Before joining Lechner Racing, Hans-Peter spent over a decade as a race engineer and later, team manager for smaller outfits, instilling in him a deep respect for resourcefulness and efficiency.

His approach to team leadership is rooted in meticulous planning and clear communication. He believes in empowering his team members, fostering an environment where innovative ideas are encouraged, and holding everyone accountable for their performance. Hans-Peter is known for his calm demeanor under pressure, a trait that has often proven decisive in tight races. His meticulous approach, bordering on perfectionism, has earned him both respect and the occasional eye-roll, but few can deny his dedication to extracting every last tenth of a second from his team's potential.

physical.description: A tall, slender man with a focused gaze and an air of quiet authority.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and race strategies.
Insists on having a Swiss chocolate bar on his desk at all times.
Tends to adjust his glasses when under pressure or deep in thought.
